title: Upstream crypto crate zeroize gaps: hkdf PRK, ccm wrapper, hmac Hmac marker, oscore Context ZeroizeOnDrop
description: Tracking bead for upstream follow-ups discovered in lx0j.1: (1) hkdf 0.13 exposes no zeroize feature - PRK buffer not type-assertable; (2) ccm 0.5 no zeroize feature - wrapper state uncovered (inner Aes128 is); (3) hmac 0.13.0 buffer_fixed! omits ZeroizeOnDrop so Hmac/HmacCore lack the marker (feature still zeroizes ipad/opad cores + CtOutput transitively); (4) patched oscore crate (/Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore) Context uses deprecated #[zeroize(drop)] attr which emits no ZeroizeOnDrop marker - adopting derive(ZeroizeOnDrop) upstream would let us tighten assert_zeroize::<Context>() to assert_zeroize_on_drop. Our assertions honestly document each gap at zeroize_asserts.rs:13-37.
